channel.title: PAGASA NCRPRSD Advisories

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 4:25 PM, 25 October 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (San Miguel, San Ildefonso, San Rafael, and Norzagaray), Nueva Ecija (General Tinio, Gapan, Penaranda, Lupao, Pantabangan, Munoz, Rizal, Llanera, General Mamerto Natividad, Palayan, Bongabon, Laur, Gabaldon, and Talavera), Quezon (General Nakar), and Rizal (Rodriguez) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad) and Nueva Ecija (Carranglan and San Jose) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
